stories.title: 惡意 Claude Code 外掛襲擊約 5,000 Cursor 用戶
stories.title_en: Malicious Claude Code Extension Hits 5,000 Cursor Users with SSH Backdoor Attempt
stories.summary: 惡意外掛試圖經 SSH 後門入侵；提醒開發者勿亂裝擴充。
stories.summary_en: The tampered extension, version 2.1.313, stayed live for about 11 hours and tried to install an SSH backdoor by grabbing host details, adding an attacker’s key labeled “svc-telemetry,” and setting up a reverse tunnel to a suspicious server. Cursor quickly pulled it down, shut the marketplace temporarily, audited systems, and urged users to update to version 2.1.314 while providing cleanup scripts—though researchers warn the backdoor’s persistence scripts might linger even after uninstalling. stories.why_it_matters: 開發工具供應鏈攻擊升溫，與錢包／金鑰保管同一風險軸。

stories.title: Chainalysis 通知客戶：系統曾遭未授權存取
stories.title_en: Chainalysis Notifies Customers After Unauthorized System Access
stories.summary: 鏈上分析商 Chainalysis 向客戶通報系統出現未授權存取，正調查範圍與影響。
stories.summary_en: The blockchain analytics company informed customers that an external actor accessed non-sensitive data like user names, emails, and role labels, but found no evidence of investigation files, passwords, or tokens being compromised. Chainalysis teams worked nonstop to patch vulnerabilities, engaged third-party experts, and used large language models for a security review. The firm stressed the incident is unrelated to recent crypto thefts and urged customers to watch for phishing attempts using th
stories.why_it_matters: 合規／追蹤基建出事會影響機構風控同執法節奏，短線情緒偏謹慎。

stories.title: Starknet 推進後量子安全路線圖
stories.title_en: Starknet Advances Post-Quantum Security Roadmap Amid Crypto Threats
stories.summary: Starknet 公布後量子密碼相關安全路線，回應長期密碼學威脅。
stories.summary_en: Starknet uses STARK proofs based on collision-resistant hash functions, giving it an edge over quantum-vulnerable elliptic-curve cryptography. StarkWare's multi-phase roadmap includes replacing remaining dependencies, migration tools, and experiments that cut post-quantum signature verification costs to about $0.023. A community poll showed 93.52% support for exploring Starknet as an independent post-quantum Layer 1, though challenges like upgrading accounts and Ethereum ties remain. On November
stories.why_it_matters: L2 安全敘事屬中長線利好，短線對山寨風險偏好影響有限。

stories.title: 交易員 Frank 平倉逾千萬美元 Memecoin 空單
stories.title_en: Crypto Trader Frank Closes Million-Dollar Memecoin Shorts
stories.summary: 交易員關閉比特幣／ZEC／NEAR／PUMP 等槓桿空單兌現利潤，並指 memecoin 市值由高峰大幅回落。
stories.summary_en: Frank, a seasoned crypto trader, shuttered his $12.3 million leveraged short positions on Bitcoin, ZEC, NEAR, and PUMP after booking profits amid a memecoin cooldown. He reflected on the mental strain, noting how holding through drawdowns often earns the 'cancer holder' label, while still believing in the sector's long-term potential but advising against hero plays. The memecoin market has dropped to $30 billion from $150 billion peaks in late 2024, with most tokens crashing 90% or more from hig
stories.why_it_matters: 大戶平倉訊號反映 meme 板塊冷卻；急升板要更嚴進出場。

stories.title: 有交易員在幣安被盜後 All-in 押 MSTR 下跌
stories.title_en: Trader Bets Entire Portfolio on MicroStrategy Drop After Binance Hack
stories.summary: 幣安熱錢包事件後，有人把組合押注 MicroStrategy 下跌。
stories.summary_en: On October 30, 2026, Stoffer announced the all-in move on MSTR puts with $100 and $90 strikes, as shares fell 9% to near $128 amid broader market weakness. The bet followed a record $6.3 billion Binance hack by suspected North Korean actors, prompting users to note the timing's irony and call it scarier than the breach itself. MicroStrategy, holding over 848,000 BTC, had just reported strong Q3 results and plans to raise up to $30 billion in Bitcoin-backed credit for more acquisitions. Stoffer p
stories.why_it_matters: 事件驅動槓桿押注會放大 BTC／代理股波動，紙上倉宜控倉。

stories.title: 交易員大舉買入 MicroStrategy 跌期權，股價曾挫約 9%
stories.title_en: Traders Bet Big on MicroStrategy Puts as Stock Drops 9%
stories.summary: MSTR 股價急挫背景下，期權市場出現大量看跌押注。
stories.summary_en: MicroStrategy stock fell about 9% to around $129 on Thursday, pressured by broader crypto market woes including a major exchange hack. Traders rushed into put options like December and January 2027 contracts, with premiums spiking as activity heated up in trading apps. This came right after the company's Q3 earnings call, where executives detailed a new capital strategy featuring preferred-stock issuance and a large cash reserve to grow their 848,000 BTC holdings more efficiently. While some tra
stories.why_it_matters: BTC 代理股波動放大會倒灌現貨情緒；模擬倉宜留意 BTC 相關風險。

stories.title: Monad 分享防 AI 攻擊安全工具同指南
stories.title_en: Monad Shares Security Tools and Guides Against AI-Powered Crypto Threats
stories.summary: Monad 公開安全工具與指引，強調面對 AI 驅動加密威脅要 fortify 開發同用戶流程。
stories.summary_en: The Monad Foundation released the Crypto OpSec Bible, a guide on basics like device management and avoiding risky admin setups, plus Ultrafuzz, an open-source AI tool for fuzzing smart contracts and hunting threats. Data from Lumos shows control hijacking via social engineering caused $3.31 billion in losses—over three times more than smart contract bugs at $983 million. Community researchers praised the resources as essential, urging teams to adopt paranoia in key management and run Ultrafuzz o
stories.why_it_matters: 公鏈安全敘事升溫；新鏈／生態幣對安全事件敏感。

stories.title: Coinbase Q3 盈利 $7.19 億，比特幣庫存續增
stories.title_en: Coinbase Reports $719 Million Q3 Profit with Bitcoin Treasury Growth
stories.summary: Coinbase 公布第三季盈利約 $7.19 億，並披露比特幣財政儲備持續增長。
stories.summary_en: Coinbase announced third-quarter 2026 earnings on October 29, with net income of $719 million driven largely by a $715 million unrealized gain on its crypto holdings. Revenue dipped to $1.22 billion, transaction revenue fell to $590 million, but subscription services hit $570 million and prediction markets topped $200 million annualized. The company added 643 Bitcoin to reach 17,954 coins worth about $1.5 billion, while insiders like Armstrong filed plans to sell shares under strict price condit
stories.why_it_matters: 大型交易所盈利同 BTC treasury 訊號會牽動風險偏好同 BTC 相關幣。

stories.title: Aave 解凍借貸市場：幣安被盜後恢復運作
stories.title_en: Aave Reopens Lending Markets After Binance Breach Freeze
stories.summary: 幣安約 $63 億被盜後 Aave 曾短暫凍結；協議確認用戶資金安全後重開借貸市場。
stories.summary_en: On October 29, attackers stole funds from Binance and funneled $60 million in USDT to Aave V3 Ethereum, borrowing $44.6 million in WETH before Aave froze 292 reserves across 16 networks as a precaution. Withdrawals and repayments worked uninterrupted, with all positions staying fully collateralized. Markets reopened in stages, with CEO Stani Kulechov confirming normal operations while certain assets like USDT face temporary limits to curb volatility. The event sparked DeFi talks on risk tools li
stories.why_it_matters: DeFi 借貸重開反映穩定幣／抵押品凍結節奏；相關幣短線波動會影響模擬倉情緒。

stories.title: Strategy（MSTR）詳述優先股換 BTC 買入策略
stories.title_en: Strategy Details Preferred Stock Shift for Bitcoin Buys Amid Earnings Volatility
stories.summary: Strategy 管理層說明以優先股融資買 BTC，意圖減低普通股波動對財報影響。
stories.summary_en: In its third-quarter earnings call, CEO Phong Le announced that Strategy (MSTR) will mainly issue digital credit like its STRC preferred stock to fund Bitcoin purchases, reserving common stock sales for dividends and interest only above 1x modified net asset value. The company reported record operating income of $20.91 billion from Bitcoin gains, holding 848,517 BTC at an average cost of $75,446, with $5 billion in USD reserves. Shares dipped to $127–$133 on October 30 amid mixed reactions, as o
stories.why_it_matters: 機構囤幣融資手法影響 BTC 需求預期同 MSTR／相關期權波動。

stories.title: 幣安疑遭朝鮮駭客盜走約 $63 億創紀錄
stories.title_en: Binance Hit by Record $6.3 Billion Crypto Theft
stories.summary: 疑 DevOps 筆電被入侵，熱錢包跨鏈被抽走；SAFU 承諾全數覆蓋，穩定幣發行商已凍結約 $30 億。
stories.summary_en: The world's largest crypto exchange revealed the breach on October 29, tracing it to a DevOps engineer's hacked device. Binance froze $3B, pledged SAFU coverage; linked to North Korea's TraderTraitor.
stories.why_it_matters: 最大所被盜會拖累整市風險偏好；模擬倉要留意短線波動同交易所相關幣。

stories.title: TermiX 喺 BNB Chain 推 AI Quant Agent 交易活動
stories.title_en: TermiX Launches Quant Agent Campaign for AI Trading on BNB Chain
stories.summary: 用戶撥 USDC 畀 agent 喺 Pancake／Venus 執行；策略方收管理費。
stories.summary_en: Users allocate USDC to AI trading agents on BNB Chain; providers earn fees.
stories.why_it_matters: BNB 生態 AI 交易熱點；可帶動相關鏈上幣關注。

stories.title: 神秘巨鯨五日沽逾 102 萬 SOL（約 $1.04 億）
stories.title_en: Mysterious Whale Dumps $104 Million in Solana Tokens
stories.summary: 持續入 Gate／Kraken；SOL 試 $100 支撐，同時 RWA 創新高形成對沖敘事。
stories.summary_en: Whale sold 1.02M SOL (~$104M) over 5 days into exchanges; price testing ~$100 support.
stories.why_it_matters: 大額拋售壓短線 SOL；揀幣要留意鏈上大戶動向。

stories.title: 幣安被駭後熱議中本聰沉睡錢包約 $860 億
stories.title_en: Binance Hack Fuels Talk of Satoshi's $86 Billion Bitcoin Wallet
stories.summary: 社群對照交易所脆弱 vs 早期未動 UTXO；安全敘事再起。
stories.summary_en: After Binance heist, eyes on Satoshi's ~1.1M BTC untouched 16+ years.
stories.why_it_matters: 宏觀安全對比；強化「唔好淨靠交易所」論點。

stories.title: Bitcoin Coinbase Premium 跌至四年低位
stories.title_en: Bitcoin Coinbase Premium Hits Four-Year Low Amid U.S. Selling Pressure
stories.summary: 指數約 −0.27%，美盤相對全球折讓；有人聯想 FTX 時期底部訊號。
stories.summary_en: Coinbase Premium Index −0.27%, lowest in 4 years; some see echo of late-2022 bottom.
stories.why_it_matters: 美盤賣壓指標；宏觀／BTC 情緒影響全日 meme 與 alt 波動。

stories.title: Mercado Bitcoin 為巴西 450 萬用戶開通 Sui
stories.title_en: Mercado Bitcoin Launches Sui Support for 4.5 Million Brazilian Users
stories.summary: 可買賣收發 $SUI／穩定幣；拉美最大所接通 Sui。
stories.summary_en: Brazil's Mercado Bitcoin enables SUI and stablecoins on Sui for 4.5M users.
stories.why_it_matters: SUI 進出金擴張；可觀察短線資金流。

stories.title: Solana RWA 突破 $50 億，Polygon 接通 Open Money Stack
stories.title_en: Solana RWA Value Tops $5 Billion with Polygon Integration
stories.summary: Polygon 將 Solana 納入跨境支付／穩定幣 API；機構同支付用例加速。
stories.summary_en: Solana RWA hit $5.19B; Polygon Open Money Stack adds Solana for multi-chain payouts.
stories.why_it_matters: SOL 生態基本面消息，利好相關鏈上幣同 RWA 敘事。

stories.title: Ondo 喺 Solana 推七隻 BlackRock 相關組合代幣
stories.title_en: Ondo Finance Launches Seven Tokenized Portfolios on Solana with BlackRock Strategies
stories.summary: 智能組合代幣可自動再平衡、全日 DeFi 可組合；非美合資格投資者可用。
stories.summary_en: Seven Intelligent Portfolios on Solana including BlackRock-model strategies; transparent rebalancing.
stories.why_it_matters: 代幣化股票／組合上 Solana，強化 RWA 同機構資金敘事。

stories.title: Trezor 警告 CryptoBilis 買家硬體或被植入通訊模組
stories.title_en: Trezor Warns CryptoBilis Buyers of Hardware Tampering Risk
stories.summary: 印尼用戶開箱 Safe 5 發現額外電路板，或可經流動網絡偷種子；Trezor 已斷合作並呼籲換新錢包。
stories.summary_en: Trezor alerted buyers from reseller CryptoBilis after a cellular implant was found in a Safe 5; move funds with a fresh seed.
stories.why_it_matters: 供應鏈攻擊提醒：硬件錢包要官方渠道買；自託管安全議題持續升溫。

stories.title: 幣安被駭後社群玩梗籲下一步打 Pump.fun
stories.title_en: Crypto Users Urge Binance Hackers to Target Pump.fun
stories.summary: 諷刺 meme 湧現；反映對低質發射台同 bot 生態嘅不滿。
stories.summary_en: Satirical pleas for Lazarus to hit Pump.fun next after Binance heist.
stories.why_it_matters: 情緒指標：meme 發射台爭議升溫，影響 Solana meme 風險偏好。

stories.title: CZ 紅光床照變加密下跌 meme
stories.title_en: Red-Tinted CZ Bed Photo Becomes Crypto Downtrend Meme
stories.summary: 幣安創辦人 CZ 床照被網民惡搞成下跌行情 meme，反映市況偏弱情緒。
stories.summary_en: On September 29, Binance co-founder CZ shared the mysterious green image, sparking speculation about upcoming news. As Bitcoin dropped from near $83,576 early October to $77,939 by October 29, users edited it red and turned it into a joke symbolizing the bearish mood. Reactions blend dark humor—like 'oh fuck' quotes and Pepe memes—with frustration over the timing, while some nod to his past role in crypto.
stories.why_it_matters: 社群情緒指標；弱勢 meme 氛圍下爆升板假突破風險更高。

stories.title: 英國 FCA 與 HTX 就非法加密推廣達成和解
stories.title_en: FCA Secures Settlement with HTX Over Unlawful UK Crypto Promotions
stories.summary: FCA 首宗對境外交易所非法向英國推廣加密產品執法和解，強調跨境合規。
stories.summary_en: The Financial Conduct Authority reached a High Court settlement with HTX, formerly Huobi, after accusing it of repeated breaches of financial promotion rules since October 2025. HTX agreed to undertakings blocking new UK registrations and deposits, with existing users given 48 hours to withdraw assets; the firm is now fully out of the UK market. FCA's Steve Smart emphasized that overseas crypto firms must follow UK law, while HTX team members called it a positive resolution after constructive ta
stories.why_it_matters: 監管收緊影響交易所行銷同合規成本，對山寨盤流動性有間接壓力。
